inputs.prompt: Two-panel development reference on almost-black background, one coherent fine GPU particle visual vocabulary, landscape 2560x1440. LEFT: refine the actual EVA eye in image 1 to feel much more formless, floating and permeable. REMOVE the rectangular skin/tissue patch entirely, including its straight top/bottom/side edges and rounded-rectangle silhouette. Preserve recognizable asymmetric upper and lower eye contours, iris and unmistakably black SQUARE pupil, composed of red fine dither/stipple points. Concentrate red samples on the iris and short eyelid arcs; irregular wisps and sparse detached particles taper organically into the void. No filled skin, no surrounding rectangle, no border, no orb, no robot face, no circular replacement pupil, no enclosing oval badge. The eye should be partially suggested rather than fully outlined, a cloud of intent with black gaps. RIGHT: keep the exact Paris point-scene composition and original material colors from image 2, with the same facades, furniture and four stationary figures. Demonstrate a gentle living point field: a small minority of colored surface samples locally displaced a few pixels, tiny moving dash accents near surfaces, sparse changing stipple coverage, while structural edge anchors and all figure silhouettes stay fixed and recognizable. Do not turn people into dust or move their bodies. Preserve warm amber, olive/brown, cream and sparse source blue/magenta. No new scenery, no full photographic surfaces, bloom, lasers, floor grids, large trails, charts, words or interface panels. This reference changes only eye boundary/point distribution and post-settlement point life; no new scene composition or construction sequence.

inputs.negative_prompt: camera motion, zoom, pan, changing perspective, walking people, moving limbs, face movement, new figures, solid surfaces, building deformation, global jitter, strobing, flashing, bloom, explosions, long trails, spirals, scene reconstruction, fade to black, scene cut
inputs.prompt: A silent five-second POST-SETTLEMENT PARTICLE-LIFE study using this exact fine-point Paris scene for both first and last frames. The camera, architecture, furniture, sign, all four people and their silhouettes are COMPLETELY FIXED throughout. Do not rebuild or reveal the scene. Keep all original sample colors and black gaps. The only continuous movement is small local motion of a minority of surface particles: tiny clusters of amber, cream, olive, blue and magenta points drift a few screen pixels tangent to their own surfaces and gently return; very short fine dashes occasionally flow along an architectural detail or pavement fragment; sparse stipple coverage changes slowly without flashing. Most defining edges stay anchored. The result feels quietly alive at all moments but remains the same composed scene, not a shaky image or a dust explosion. No person locomotion, no new objects, no sweeping scanner, no solid photographic fill. Return naturally near the starting distribution by the last frame; this is a restrained qualitative motion reference, not a claim of measured scanning or a guaranteed seamless loop.
